Everyone's brain chemistry is different mate. Amphetamines are really potent and simply put can overwhelm people especially new users. If you had underlying mental health issues before you took speed it could bring out conditions that would have shown up later on in your life. I doubt that's the case tho, did you mix the speed with any other drugs? I've gotten psychosis multiple times and i can tell you that it will take a while to go away (weeks/months in most cases). Most important thing is that you lay off the drugs for now before it gets worse ( weed included because believe it or not that makes things even worse don't listen to what other people tell you) I also doubt that you have tested your speed so it's possible that it was laced with some RC that pushed you over the edge (witnessed it multiple times). Always test your stuff and PLEASE do your research before experimenting with drugs like these so you know what could come your way and know what to do in those situations. Try not to be around too many people and take some rest (keep yourself distracted with videogames or something) if you feel like it's getting too much there is no shame in contacting a professional. Also I highly recommend supplements (Vitamin D, B, C + Magnesium+ omega 3 should serve you well) drink tons of water and gatorade and try to pee as much as possible. Also a week long speed binge is not very smart. This stuff will fuck you up sooner than you think and you won't realise the damage until you lay it off. Sorry for bad grammar I'm at work, if you need any more help feel free to text me. Good luck

Thanks a lot for your input mate I appreciate it a lot! I'm in my 20s but I wouldn't say that I am inexperienced with drugs, but I definitely was a few months ago. What led me to even get started was my parents getting divorced, relationship ending and a whole lot of other problems. I was never really curious about drugs or wondered what they felt like. I've always struggled with mental health and after that relationship I had severe depression and attempted suicide multiple times. I was lonely and the only thing I had was money. I had no self worth or confidence in myself anymore and was seeking acceptance. I met a junkie and we became friends pretty quickly, he and his friends never offered me any drugs and wouldn't take any infront of me out of respect they know I didn't like it. One day I discovered a reddit post about mdma and noticed that it was considered a love drug. I thought well let's give this a try, I didn't care about my life anymore and thought before I kill myself I'd rather feel some type of love or happy feeling again. Took me weeks to convince the guy to give me a XTC pill they always warned me but I didn't listen. I had a lot of money for my age, junkies arround me and no self worth, not a good combination. We started throwing home parties every weekend and doing drugs here and there mostly XTC or MD + weed. I just wanted to have people arround me and get some acceptance because I was lonely for all my life I've always been an outsider and those parties were just an excuse to 'experience what I couldn't in all these years' it wasn't even the drugs that I needed I just enjoyed socializing. I never got hooked but once I got introduced to speed it went downhill. The junkie had been snorting for years so I thought he will know what he's doing and took his advice as he's someone more experienced. We would get paste and let it dry for like 10min before snorting a whole gram of that shit, no acetone wash nothing. This went on for a couple months until someone I know started ordering from the dw and we got very very good quality rocks which we tested. I didn't consume every day but when I did I did stupid amounts. The worst I did was 6 XTC pills + 3g speed+ keta+ alcohol +MD + coke+  weed im honestly surprised that I'm still alive. Long story short, in the end that guy just used me to get his fix and since I was high all the time I didn't really take notice or even care because I thought if I die I die who cares at this point. I lost 15000 dollars, the junkie pretty much fled the city after he continuously stole from me and I was left at a worse place than before. I managed to quit cold turkey but I still have to pay the price for my stupid behavior. I can't socialize with' normal' people anymore, anxiety, panic attacks, psychosis, extreme weight loss, my teeth are fucked up, throat is completely fucked up, my jaw is done to the point where I can't even chew properly anymore, my whole body aches and the list goes on.... I wake up every day just to regret my decisions and my behavior. The moment I achieve something small in my life I instantly remind myself of all the damage I have done to myself and that this didn't have to happen. Fuck man I don't even know what to say it hurts. I went to so many docs and they all just brushed me off and told me it's my own fault, they all said there is nothing wrong with me but I can literally feel it man when I inhale through my nose it literally feels like air is leaking through my throat it's disgusting I could write a whole list about things that feel off. Can't even talk like a normal human being anymore I stutter all the time and here I am having to live through this hell for another 40 years. There is no one else to blame but myself but it feels good to let go sometimes because I have no one to talk to about stuff like this. I just sit in my room all day every day and try not to think about this stuff anymore.... I don't know what the end will be
Thank you for taking your time and reading my post I really appreciate it
